entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I'm a bit lost. I bought something, and I think I need to send it back. I just don't understand how.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me which item you're calling about?
It's the... the helmet. I ordered a helmet and it's not right. The website was so confusing.
Okay, I understand. I can look into the return options for your helmet. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the color. It just... it looked different on the screen, you know? It doesn't match my bike at all. The box is still unopened, if that helps. I haven't even touched it. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered about 40 days ago. Is that correct?
I guess? I'm not sure. It's just been sitting there. I've been so worried I couldn't return it.

No need to worry. For a standard item like a helmet, our VeloFit return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this for you.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy and, most importantly, that your gear meets your expectations for both style and safety. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, I see it! It just came through. This is much easier than I thought. Thank you, Charlie.
My pleasure. Just print that label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
